    n = len(s)
    max_length = 0
    
    # Check for tandem repeats within the original string
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n + 1):
            substring = s[i:j]
            doubled_substring = substring + substring
            if doubled_substring in s + s[:k]:
                max_length = max(max_length, len(doubled_substring))
    
    return max_length
